name: Motion and presence sensors
summary: Sensors that detect people and movement: PIR, microwave radar, ultrasonic and beam sensors.
uses: Lights that switch on when someone passes
Detecting animals at a pen or crop
identify: White domed or faceted lenses on security lights, alarm sensors and automatic doors; flat radar modules in some lights; round ultrasonic pairs in car parking sensors.
test: Power it (PIR boards usually take 5–12V) and wave a hand: the output should switch. PIRs need up to a minute to settle after power-up.
